summary: Enhanced Group Inc. filed an 8-K reporting a November 4, 2026 securities purchase agreement for a $15 million private placement of 2,109,705 Class A shares at $7.11 per share to accredited investors, including related parties Enhanced Holdings LP and its nominee Apeiron Investment Group. Oppenheimer acts as lead placement agent with Canaccord Genuity as co-agent. Closing follows effectiveness of a stockholder consent and distribution of an information statement. Warrants from the June 2026 placement reset to $7.11 per share, adding up to 5,747,000 shares. This is ordinary private financing, not a special situation.
